component.name: Drive Migrator
component.summary: Migrate files, mail, calendars and contacts between cloud accounts

description.p: Drive Migrator copies data between Google (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Contacts) and Microsoft (OneDrive, Outlook Mail, Calendar, Contacts) accounts. Copies never delete or change anything in the source account.

ul.li: Two panes: pick an account on each side and copy in either direction
Checksum verification of every copied file
Sign-ins through your own OAuth clients, with tokens kept in the OS credential store
